# VINTF Manifest – Complete HAL Stack (45 Files)

All 45 VINTF manifest files from `/system/vendor/etc/vintf/manifest/`.

## Critical Files (TEE / Security)

| File | Function |
| :--- | :--- |
| `trusty-default.xml` | TEE (TrustZone) |
| `android.hardware.security.keymint@2.0-unisoc.service.trusty.xml` | KeyMint + SecureClock + SharedSecret + RPK |
| `android.hardware.gatekeeper@1.0-service.trusty.xml` | Gatekeeper (auth) |
| `ifaa-default.xml` | Biometric auth (IFAA) |
| `soter_default.xml` | Secure provisioning |
| `tui-default.xml` | Trusted UI |

## Other Critical Files

| File | Function |
| :--- | :--- |
| `vendor-oemlock-default.xml` | Bootloader unlock control |
| `cplog_svc-default.xml` | Baseband logging |
| `vendor.sprd.gnss-default.xml` | GNSS/GPS control |
| `manifest_dualsim.xml` | Dual SIM management |
| `unionpnp_service-default.xml` | UniPnP performance |
| `android.hardware.usb-service.unisoc.xml` | USB/JTAG control |

## Integrity

All files have SHA-256 hashes generated by GitHub. See file metadata for verification.
